name: Top Class Education for ST Students
short_description: Scholarship for ST students admitted on merit to MoTA-notified premier institutions and approved courses.
department: Ministry of Tribal Affairs, Government of India
degree_level: Notified graduate / postgraduate courses in India
stipend_amount: Tuition/admission fees (private cap ₹2.5 lakh/year), ₹3,000 monthly stipend, ₹5,000 books/year, one-time computer assistance ₹45,000

validation_rules.label: Scheduled Tribe category
validation_rules.expected: Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Tribe category in their domicile State/UT.

validation_rules.label: Annual family income
validation_rules.expected: Combined parental income limit ₹6,00,000/year; spouse income included for married candidates; orphan guardian exception applies

validation_rules.label: Course level
validation_rules.expected: Graduate or postgraduate study in an approved course

validation_rules.label: Notified institution and course
validation_rules.expected: Institution and course must be on MoTA notified list

validation_rules.label: Management quota
validation_rules.expected: Management-quota admission at private institute is ineligible

validation_rules.label: Other scholarship
validation_rules.expected: Cannot claim another Centre/State scholarship for the same study

required_documents.name: Admission proof
required_documents.description: Admission letter showing course and merit basis

required_documents.name: Notified institute/course proof
required_documents.description: Evidence matching current MoTA notified list

form_fields.name: annual_family_income
form_fields.label: Combined parental income plus spouse income if married (INR)

form_fields.name: notified_institution
form_fields.label: Institution and course on MoTA notified list

selection_notes: All eligible students admitted on merit to notified institutes/courses may be eligible after institute and Ministry verification; no institute/state/stream slot ceiling stated.
The official current list of 252 institutes and approved courses is external data and must be maintained by administrators; this prototype only collects a declaration.
